description: Unmodified contiguous 22 s source crops selected by upstream speech onsets. Same-crop full-context comparison; overlapping crops are not independent. Native noise retry truth unknown. Probability tap preserves detector decisions.

counts.note: Diagnostic speech comparisons only; no native retry truth or pass/fail accuracy gate.
